D: Four scientists set up shop above a Chinese restaurant and start catching ghosts across Manhattan.
P: Serve the snacks when the wonton soup arrives with hardly any wontons.
S: the running joke about the soup with almost no wontons
Pork and prawn wontons folded and simmered in chicken stock with ginger and soy, loaded into bowls with bok choy so there are more wontons than soup.

Pork, cabbage, carrot and vermicelli rolled tight in pastry, fried until crisp and blistered, with sweet chilli sauce and fresh lettuce cups. Soak 50g rice vermicelli and cut short. Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 2 garlic cloves and grated ginger, then add 2 cups shredded wombok and a grated carrot for 2 minutes. Stir in the noodles, 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy, then cool. Roll tightly in 16 spring roll wrappers, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with sweet chilli and lettuce leaves.
getting slimed by the ghost at the mansion
Avocado, edamame, lime, garlic and coriander blitzed bright green, served with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks.
M: the Chinese restaurant under their office
Sweet and sour pork with pineapple and capsicum, crisp battered pieces tossed in a sauce of vinegar, sugar and tomato, and egg fried rice.
Times Square onion sauce hot dogs

All-beef franks griddled until split, in soft buns with spicy brown mustard, sweet onions stewed in tomato and a little chilli, and pickle relish. Slice 2 onions thinly and cook in oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until soft. Add 3 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp sugar, half a tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp vinegar and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick and sticky. Griddle 8 all-beef franks until blistered and split. Warm 8 hot dog buns. Fill with franks, mustard, the onion sauce and a spoon of pickle relish.
W: Thin batter of egg white, sugar, flour and vanilla baked at 180C in small rounds for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while still hot.
K: the green slime all over Erin

Kiwifruit blitzed with lime juice, mint and sugar syrup, poured over crushed ice and topped with fizzy soda water so it foams up bright green. Dissolve 60g sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. Peel 4 kiwifruit and blitz with the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint leaves and the syrup until smooth. Spoon into four tall glasses over crushed ice. Top each slowly with 150ml cold soda water so it foams up, stir once and add a lime wheel.

s.note: the running joke about the soup with almost no wontons
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, grated ginger and soy. Fill wonton wrappers and fold. Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with ginger slices and soy, add the wontons and cook 4 minutes. Add halved bok choy for the last minute and load up the bowls.

s.note: getting slimed by the ghost at the mansion
s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed edamame, the juice of 2 limes, a crushed garlic clove, a handful of coriander and salt until smooth and very green. Spoon into a bowl and serve with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks for dipping.

m.note: the Chinese restaurant under their office
m.how: Cut 600g pork scotch fillet into chunks, coat in cornflour and fry until crisp. Simmer rice vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce, add pineapple pieces and sliced capsicum and toss the pork through. Serve with egg fried rice made from cold long grain rice.

w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites with 80g sugar, then mix in 60g flour, 30g melted butter and a drop of vanilla. Spread thin rounds on a lined tray and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Working fast while hot, lay a paper fortune on each, fold in half and bend over a cup edge.
